title: List Event Subcategories
description: For event types that have subcategories, this pages through the available subcategories. A subcategory definition may include an optional `displayName` property. If so, user agents that show the results as a list should show that value to users instead of the `subcategory` value.

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: The name of an event type that has subcategories, as returned by the [List Event Types](../list-event-types) API.

parameters.name: pagination_token
parameters.description: Optional pagination token, for retrieving further results after a previous page request.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Optional limit to the number of values returned. If not specified,
the max (1000) values are returned.

subcategory.description:
The subcategory value. This is the value used when configuring endpoints that
receive event messages for this subcategory.

display_name.description:
A user-friendly display name for the subcategory. If empty, user agents should
show the subcategory value.

subcategory_defs.description: The list of subcategory definitions, up to the requested limit.

next_pagination_token.description:
If present, this pagination token can be supplied in a subsequent request to get
the next batch of results. If not present, there are no further results.
